verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a SaaS notarization and incorporation service with a REST API, so an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack shows only REST endpoints, webhooks and llms.txt files, with no MCP server. llms.txt and REST APIs are developer building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
